notes: Roach Modbus Tool v1.3.4 - Poll: several devices can now share one connection. Devices may use the same TCP IP and port (or the same serial port), for example a short watch list next to a large register table; the device still sees one master, and a serial port is opened once. Each device still connects, polls and disconnects on its own: the connection opens with the first device and closes with the last. Devices on one connection must use the same timeout, retries and serial settings; editing one asks and changes the others. The device list is grouped by connection, like Slave: right-click a connection header, or use Connection > Connect All / Disconnect All on This Connection, to connect or disconnect every device on it. Add device starts from the selected device's settings and joins its connection when that connection is up; otherwise the new device stays offline. Fixed a crash when a table cell was opened for editing while a Chinese or Japanese input method was composing. Poll: Apply format changes only the settings you tick (it used to reset the format to Signed); the Engineering dialog no longer suggests that an Eng. Value can be typed in (write the raw value); the device list updates when a Slave ID is added or removed. Slave: Stop then Listen keeps the value of every address, not only those in the register table; pressing Listen no longer marks the project as changed. A serial port that will not open now says why: it does not exist, it is in use, or (Linux) the user needs the dialout group. Script: Read, Write and Wait Until with a computed address and a count use the whole range; Pause, and steps that finish just before a long Wait, show their result right away; clearer log lines for not-equal checks, tolerance, If / While and Wait Until no response; invalid JSON names the line and column; --run-script prints only the run log and summary on standard output.
